plans.idea: Faithful centered vertical stack like the original: small logo lockup on top, bottle as the clear centerpiece, headline plus subhead block, then a centered pill CTA, all on one central axis with even vertical rhythm.
Two-column split that suits the wider-than-tall shape: large bottle fills the left column, and a left-aligned right column reads logo, headline, subhead, CTA top to bottom on a shared left edge.

Headline-first: a full-width text band leads across the top at maximum size, then a lower row pairs the bottle on the left with the CTA and brand lockup stacked on the right, so the eye goes message, product, action, brand.
